title: 1UZ Turbo Base Tune
author: VictorTH
summary: Starting profile for a Toyota 1UZ setup, intended for initial naturally aspirated or turbo use and limited to 3500 RPM in the source notes.
notes: Imported from the EpicEFI base-map library. Source notes specify Honda K24 coils, OEM 240 cc/min injectors, 36-2 crank trigger, Hall crank/cam sensors, GM electronic throttle body and BMW E46 pedal sensor. The base-map site INI had signature rusEFI master.2026.01.05.M144F7RED.1240587255; the exact matching definition was resolved from firmware/2026-01-08/rusefi_bundle_M144F7RED.zip (rusefi.snapshot.M144F7RED/rusefi_M144F7RED.ini).
